title: Conditional SCIM provisioning + Periodic Access Sentinel
creator: Maya R. Chen
description: Implement a conditional SCIM provisioning pipeline and a Periodic Access Sentinel job that together automate regional residency-aware provisioning, reconcile account state, and produce signed evidence bundles for auditors. Goals: (1) add attribute-driven provisioning rules to SCIM connector (e.g., region, org_tier, compliance_profile) so accounts are provisioned into tenant-scoped RBAC groups and region-specific VPCs; (2) add an incremental reconcile job that performs batched SCIM pulls with delta detection and writes granular audit events to the compliance event stream; (3) implement a Periodic Access Sentinel that runs configurable review cycles (monthly/quarterly/annual) and produces an evidence export (signed, versioned JSON + CSV) to S3 with retention metadata and KMS encryption; (4) wire these outputs to the evidence automation pipeline (signed manifests and Confluence summary) so PMs and auditors can consume them. Considerations: data residency — all reconciliation and evidence exports must run in the customer region (EU/US/APAC) and never copy PII outside region; retention controls are parametric per-tenant and expire evidence blobs; we must balance reconciliation freshness vs API rate limits and SCIM provider throttling. This ticket covers changes to the SCIM orchestration service, the sentinel scheduler, audit-event schema additions, and documentation for support/PM teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SCIM connector supports conditional rules based on attributes (region, compliance_profile) and unit tests cover rule evaluation; 2) Reconcile job can run incrementally and emit per-identity audit events to the compliance event stream (verified in staging dashboard); 3) Sentinel runs a scheduled review for a demo org, produces a signed evidence bundle stored in region-specific S3 with KMS encryption and retention metadata; 4) Evidence bundle format and Confluence summary meet security/PM checklist and pass security review; 5) No PII is exported outside the tenant region during any step; 6) Metrics: reconcile latency under 10s per 1k accounts and evidence generation completes within configured SLA (default 30m for up to 50k accounts).
comments: 2026-02-12 - kicked off design sync. Decided on attribute-driven rules vs separate provisioning pipelines for each region to reduce maintenance overhead. Action: Diego to prototype rule matcher in sandbox.

2026-02-19 - prototype complete. Matcher supports boolean expressions and precedence for group assignments. Trade-off: expression engine adds CPU cost but reduces rule duplication. Added cache TTL for matcher results to mitigate cost.
2026-02-26 - security review pre-check: encryption-at-rest and in-transit validated; flagged requirement for KMS key usage per-region. Asked Security to approve key policy template (SEC-PR-112).

2026-03-03 - integration notes: SCIM provider rate limits vary; we will default to adaptive backoff and windowed batching. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7812 (scim: conditional provisioning + matcher).

2026-03-08 - QA found an edge case: duplicate externalIds cause group drift during reconcile. Temporary mitigation: dedupe by externalId + normalized email, longer-term action: add idempotency tokens at provisioning layer.
2026-03-10 - updated acceptance criteria with performance SLOs. Started work on evidence manifest signer. Assigned to Diego for implementation, Maya for docs + runbook.
2026-03-10 - PM feedback (Nora Patel): add a flag for tenant admins to opt-in/out of automated remediation during sentinel runs. Diego to checkbox this in UI and API design.
notes: Design decisions: favor expression-based rules (small DSL) to cover most tenant needs rather than shipping separate connectors for each compliance region.
Trade-offs: batched reconcile reduces API cost but increases time-to-detect drift; we'll add near-real-time hooks for high-risk groups.
Follow-ups: (a) expose evidence retention controls in tenant settings UI, (b) add 'last_provisioned_at' metric to tenant dashboard, (c) post-mortem template for any compliance export incidents.
